steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: This building actually extends downwards...

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: An old colleague told me the owner of this place loves the sea, hence designed it to extend downwards to simulate the depths and romance of the sea.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: The architecture is quite rare for Eastside, so it became very popular. A lot of exhibitions and parties are held here.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: But... doesn't this make you feel like you're trapped in darkness? A bit scary, come to think of it...

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: You think that's scary? I once heard a legend about an Eastside gourmet who even ate people to fulfill her culinary pursuits!

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: I think that's what's really scary...

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Ehhhh!
The manual only marks the different floor levels: the open-air pool and restaurant are on Level 1, the game and recreation area is on Level B1, and the banquet hall is on Level B2.
You originally thought you'd go to the dinner banquet right away. It should be on Level B2, but the location is all you know about the dinner right now.
You can only follow the higher-ups' instructions, mingle into the event as much as possible, gain intelligence without anyone noticing, then finally help Miss Cabernet recover her "treasures."
Yes, and bring back the Sinner in the Thaumas Society.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We have far too few clues right now. We haven't even seen the client yet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They say it's a feast to "please all tastes." And the guests are randomly chosen from Eastside and even Syndicate. Now that I've seen it myself, it really is quite extraordinary.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Maybe this is their tactic—with everyone's spirits at their highest points, even if there are Sinners around, I can't detect them unless they use their powers.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Then... what should we do...

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: I really hope I won't mess this mission up...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's okay. Didn't you socialize with those girls quite well just now? Just keep that up.

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: I didn't expect to meet my customers from before...

steps.speaker: Macchiato
steps.content: Although it's a bit embarrassing... I think I might be able to get some clues from them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll leave it to you, then.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: By the way, Kelvin, I heard that you like Miss Cabernet as much as the other guests here. She's our client this time, so maybe you'll get the chance to get her autograph.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Miss Cabernet...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. She's our client.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: No, no... what I mean is...

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: I see Miss Cabernet. Over there!
